notes.title: Phantom Beasts Team - Origin Story
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=WrfxPSCSbm8;full][/previewyoutube]
Phantom beast is all about dark badass Pokémon-like creatures and you don't just send them out 
like a coach you fight alongside them shoulder to shoulder like a real team-mate.
it all started from crazy idea about a video game and a TV show  

I actually wrote the pilot and the bible for this TV show. It too me about 18 months and 10 drafts until everyone said: "this is some epic S**t right here".
but somehow Netflix and Amazon ain't really standing in line to make this super expensive TV show so I did what every normal person would do: quit my job and start my own indie game.

lucky me I've been joined by some very talented guys along the way: 
Guy Nagar, Dor Ben Dor, Moshe Gilboa, Zevik Perry, Ido adler and Alon Talmi.
we're getting enormous help from ilya one of the best concept artists I've seen.
hands  down is the best team I've ever worked with.

Now the game's narrative takes place about 20 years after the events of the TV show it follows hunter, who is helping the resistance, being chased and forced into the quarantine zone.
he's about to die from immense amounts of radiation and then Timogo  a Gorilla / Owl - Phantom, who's also working with the resistance...  he needs hunter to stay alive.

So Timogo decides to save hunter by combining the two of them together in one of the first successful connections between humans and phantoms. from that point on they become each other's special abilities, but inside hunter's mind Timogo starts to sniff around and he's got 
some dark secrets over there i'll tell you that...   some past traumatic events that hunter is keeping 
locked away from Timogo and the player.

That's it for today 
next time we'll jump in, and show you what the team has been working on. so leave us a comment about what is interesting for you about  our development process

notes.title: Our First Dev Log
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=EsWHk5oell4;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey Guys Welcome to our first DevLog of Phantom Beasts.

Phantom Beasts is a 2.5D shooter, where you play as a former Phantom Hunter.
You collect different phantoms with special abilities. Each one gives you different advantages in combat.

The Spider is a throwable torrent, enabling you to overcome clusters of enemies and enemies which are hard to reach.

The TimeFox grants you the ability to slow time, giving you the upper hand when confronting tight situations and suppressing fire.

All of the phantoms’ and hunter’s abilities are upgradable via the skill tree, that way you can maximize your preferred play style.

Our next phantom - Timogo, is  a real game changer. stay tuned for the next video to discover his abilities and role in Hunter’s journey for REDEMPTION.

Watch the video for more information on the combat.

Also, we would like to invite you to join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/w24gT6ptKS]Discord[/url], our Steam forum, and follow us on our social media channels: [url=https://twitter.com/beasts_phantom]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC8OPQYmnUZQ-2D_Q7tnEFlg]Youtube[/url]. Please Wishlist and follow the game, maybe even... tell your friends about it ? what ever - go crazy !

We will come back very soon with more news and Dev Logs.
